select id, skuId, skuNo, productName, warehouseId, warehouseName, virtualQty, virtualUsableQty, virtualFrozenQty, realQty, usableQty, frozenQty, inTransitQty, waitQcQty, totalVirtualQty from (WITH VirtualInventory AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ), Inventory AS ( SELECT min(id) as id, sku_id, warehouse_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS usableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozenQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS inTransitQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'waitQc' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS waitQcQty FROM inventory WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id ) SELECT i.id, i.sku_id AS skuId, pd.sku_no AS skuNo, pd.name AS productName, i.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, wh.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(vi.virtualQty, 0) as virtualQty, COALESCE(vi.virtualUsableQty, 0) as virtualUsableQty, COALESCE(vi.virtualFrozenQty, 0) as virtualFrozenQty, COALESCE(i.usableQty, 0) + COALESCE(i.frozenQty, 0) as realQty, COALESCE(i.usableQty, 0) AS usableQty, COALESCE(i.frozenQty, 0) AS frozenQty, COALESCE(i.inTransitQty, 0) AS inTransitQty, COALESCE(i.waitQcQty, 0) AS waitQcQty, COALESCE(sum(vi.virtualQty)over(PARTITION BY vi.warehouse_id,vi.sku_id),0) AS totalVirtualQty FROM Inventory i LEFT JOIN ( select sku_id,warehouse_id,sum(virtualQty) as virtualQty,sum(virtualUsableQty) as virtualUsableQty,sum(virtualFrozenQty) as virtualFrozenQty from VirtualInventory group by sku_id,warehouse_id ) vi ON vi.sku_id = i.sku_id AND vi.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON i.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN warehouse wh ON i.warehouse_id = wh.id AND wh.is_deleted = false
1 = 1
${params.permissionSql}
and vi.sku_id is not null
) diff
${params.sqlMap.default}
and diff.totalVirtualQty > diff.usableQty + diff.frozenQty
and diff.usableQty + diff.frozenQty >= diff.totalVirtualQty
and diff.totalVirtualQty > diff.usableQty
and diff.usableQty >= diff.totalVirtualQty
and (diff.virtualQty > 0 or diff.virtualUsableQty > 0 or diff.virtualFrozenQty > 0 or diff.realQty > 0 or diff.usableQty > 0 or diff.frozenQty > 0 or diff.inTransitQty > 0 or diff.waitQcQty > 0 or diff.totalVirtualQty > 0)
order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
diff.skuId asc,diff.warehouseId asc
